subject: Insurance
title: The Direct-to-Consumer Revolution
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Direct-to-Consumer Revolution.

hook.text: GEICO and Progressive bypassed traditional agents and sold auto insurance directly to consumers.

buildup.text: Traditional insurers used local agents who earned 10-15% commissions.

discovery.text: GEICO's 'fifteen minutes could save you fifteen percent' campaign became iconic.

twist.text: Independent agents are fighting back with personalized service.

climax.text: Direct-to-consumer changed auto insurance from a relationship business to a price-comparison sport.

punchline.text: Skip the agent, get a quote online.

quiz.question: How did direct-to-consumer insurers gain market share?
options: Eliminating agent commissions and offering lower prices
